1.

Behold the Lamb, crowned in glory, With honour and all power! He shall be praised eternally For the work He has accomplished.

2.

He fills the throne, highly exalted, With righteousness He sits there. He is the joy of the redeemed, With the Father chosen, beloved.

3.

Though He is on the Father’s throne, Our song He does not despise, The weakest, the faintest tone Reaches His ear on high.

4.

With one accord we bring our song To the glory of His name, To Him who is upon the throne, The slain Lamb of God.

5.

He, who was here despised by men And patiently endured scorn, Now bears the crown of glory In majesty and power.
